title: Generalized Sasaki-Einstein metric twisted with Weil-Petersson metric
summary: Existence of canonical metric on a Sasakian variety was a long standing conjecture and the major part of this conjecture is about varieties which do not have definite basic first Chern class . Most of the Sasakian varieties do not have definite basic first Chern class. We give a program by using Fujino's Minimal Model program to find canonical metric on the canonical model of Sasakian varieties.
